title: When Audio-Language Models Fail to Leverage Multimodal Context for Dysarthric Speech Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating transcription performance (Word Error Rate, Character Error Rate, and SemScore) on dysarthric and atypical speech across various etiologies (e.g., ALS, Cerebral Palsy, Parkinson's disease, Down syndrome) and analyzing how explicit clinical context prompting affects error rates, hallucinations, and model behavior.
